summary.tldr: The bill gives extra federal payments to provinces and territories and adds a one-time extra GST/HST credit payment.
what_it_does: Authorizes additional payments to provinces and territories under the Federal-Provincial Fiscal Arrangements Act.
Provides an extra GST/HST credit payment equal to double the regular January 2023 payment under the Income Tax Act.
summary.background: Bill C-46 was introduced in the House of Commons on 29 March 2023 and received first reading.
